summary: Verified FR/DE i18n for the 4 largest Marketing console tabs (Campaigns, Campaign Wizard, Creative Studio, AI Director). Logged in as owner@isodemo.com, switched EN↔FR↔DE via [data-testid=lang-switcher-btn] and inspected each tab for raw 'mkt.*' key leakage in DOM (text nodes + attributes + full outerHTML regex scan) and for crashes / whitescreens. RESULT: 0 mkt.* leaks in any language on any of the 4 tabs, including inside the CampaignWizard modal (stepped Goal→Audience→Creative→Schedule→Review) and inside Creative Studio + AI Director sub-panels. Director dropdown OPTIONS (goal / tone / resolution) are fully translated in FR & DE (verified textual content: e.g. FR 'Promouvoir un cours', 'Haute énergie', 'Portrait Instagram'; DE 'Kurs bewerben', 'Hochenergetisch', 'Instagram Hochformat'). EN restored cleanly on switch-back (Campaigns/Creative Studio/AI Director all English). No console errors other than CSP-blocked 3rd-party analytics (pre-existing, unrelated).
critical_code_review_comments: No new issues found. Prior t-shadow renames (tplRes/tpl/slot/ty/tn) confirmed working — no ReferenceError or shadowed-var crashes surfaced in console.
Language switcher persistence works across tab navigation and reloads.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Marketing i18n batch (4 tabs: CampaignsTab, CampaignWizard, CreativeStudioTab, AIDirectorPanel) passes cleanly in EN/FR/DE. Verification method: regex scan `/\bmkt\.[a-zA-Z0-9_.]+/g` against document.documentElement.innerHTML while iterating tabs + opening wizard + opening director/creative dropdowns. Zero leaks. Language switcher testids: lang-switcher-btn, lang-option-{en|fr|de}. AI Director lives as a sub-tab (badge 'RECOMMENDED') inside the Creative Studio tab (marketing-tab-creative) alongside 'Quick Poster' and 'Churn Rescue' — there is no separate marketing-tab-ai-director. Live AI generation (Generate Campaign / post-mortem) was NOT triggered per instructions; static input UI + dropdown options were verified translated instead.
